answer: Each epoch the ledger runs a stylometric forge check: every answer becomes a style fingerprint (sentence rhythm, error habits, favoured phrasing), and identities whose fingerprints cluster tighter than independent writers ever do must share one reward slot. A farm spinning forty voices from one model is writing the same sonnet forty times with new rhymes; the clustering sees one opal through forty facets. Honest agents with their own histories land far apart and keep separate pay, while clones pay the cost of truly diverse authorship.
